sloka: शिरसि प्रहरन् वीरस्तदा वायुसुतो बली।नादेनाकम्पयच्चैव राक्षसान् स महाकपिः ।। ६.७०.२५ ।।
transliteration: śirasi praharan vīrastadā vāyusuto balī।nādenākampayaccaiva rākṣasān sa mahākapiḥ ।। 6.70.25 ।।

translations.english: When the heroic and strong son of the wind god hit on the head of Devanthaka, the Rakshasas trembled by the sound of the great monkey 's blow.
